questions.prompt: Which document begins with the words We the People?
questions.fact: The original draft opened by listing the states individually. It was shortened when nobody could be sure which would ratify.

questions.prompt: Which gas do fireflies use in the reaction that makes them glow?
questions.fact: The reaction is nearly 100 percent efficient, wasting almost no energy as heat, which no light bulb comes close to.

questions.prompt: Which sport is played on the largest standard field?
questions.fact: A full-size pitch is around nine football fields in area, which is part of why the sport stayed expensive.

questions.prompt: Which long-running British soap is set in a fictional Yorkshire farming village?
questions.fact: It began as a daytime programme called Emmerdale Farm and only dropped the farm from its title in 1989.

questions.prompt: Which continent has the most countries?
questions.fact: It has 54, a number that owes more to the borders drawn in Berlin in 1885 than to anything on the ground.

questions.prompt: Which novel features the character Sydney Carton?
questions.fact: Its closing line about a far, far better thing is among the most quoted endings in English fiction.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym GIF stand for?
questions.fact: Its creator insisted the name is pronounced with a soft g, and lost that argument comprehensively.
